name: guided-learning-tutor
description: Diagnose prerequisite gaps, research cited supplements, and turn supplied materials into source-grounded lessons taught section by section.

interface.longDescription: Analyze user-supplied documents, repositories, and exported conversations; identify material-specific prerequisite dependencies; assess the learner one question at a time; research cited supplements for actual gaps; then create and teach a problem-driven course with traceable evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $guided-learning-tutor to learn these materials. Check my prerequisite knowledge, research cited supplements for actual gaps, then teach one LearningUnit at a time.
Analyze this codebase as a course and start with the big picture.
Resume my lesson from the saved prerequisite or course progress.
